description.short: UKG Bryte — Bring your HR and workforce data into Copilot
description.full: UKG Bryte — Bring your HR and workforce data into Copilot via the public UKG MCP server. Skills: UKG Directory (read-only employee directory, employment details, work location, email, and org-chart/reporting views), and Time Off & Accruals (check balances, submit and track time-off requests, review accrual history, and manager time-off/schedule views). Beta Early Access: UKG customer administrators can apply for access here: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/YW9VYAREkN

agentConnectors.description: UKG Bryte public MCP server for HR and workforce data (directory, time off and accruals).
